claims.evidence: No photo shows the contents (accessories or the number/type of games). Only the outer box packaging is visible.

risks.risk: Item identity mismatch (box may not contain a PS4 'big' or may be a different model/region than claimed).
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the console itself showing the model/serial label (including model number) and the region/label details, plus a close-up of the box label with readable model text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown boxed console (worst case: not confirmed PS4 model/region), with no guarantee of contents.

risks.risk: Contents not complete (accessories and '7 games' may be missing or fewer than claimed).
risks.proof: A photo/video inventory laid out on a surface: console, controllers/pads, cables, manuals, and each game disc/cartridge clearly counted and shown.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/contents unverified (worst case: accessories and games not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Not actually tested/working (ports may be faulty; overheating may exist).
risks.proof: A short power-on test video showing: HDMI output on TV, controller pairing, at least one game launching, and close-ups of multiple ports (USB/HDMI/Ethernet) while connected.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: may be faulty), treating it like 'as-is' with no functional confirmation.

risks.risk: Condition/repair status unknown (could be previously opened, repaired, or has hidden damage).
risks.proof: Photos of seals (if any), internal inspection shots (if seller can open), and close-ups of vents/thermal areas plus any repair marks; also show serial number match between box and console.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case used condition with no repair/overheating assurances.

risks.risk: Receipt/region claim may be fabricated (UK receipt and 'Japan' region not verifiable from current photos).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the receipt with date/store details and a close-up of the console label showing region/model; ensure serial number matches.
risks.if_unproven: Price without relying on receipt/region proof.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the box label with readable brand/model/region text.
Send photos of the console model/serial label (and confirm it matches the box).
Show a full contents layout: console + controllers/pads + all cables + manuals + and a counted list of the games (each game clearly visible).
Provide a short working test video: power on, HDMI display, controller pairing, and launching one game; include close-ups of ports while connected.
Show any seals and/or evidence of 'never opened' status (or explain if opened) and provide receipt photo if available.
response.reason: The witness report only confirms a boxed, packaged item with no readable PS4/model/contents details, so a worst-case price cannot be set reliably without proof of identity, completeness, and working status.
